changelog: **Placement ledger (#1765):** a hire now stamps a `Placement` row automatically — the new `placement` subscriber of `pipeline.stage_change` (`src/lib/events/subscribers/placement.ts` → `syncPlacementForRelation()` in `src/lib/placementLedger.ts`) reconciles the relation's CURRENT stage against the org's resolved hire stages (`outcomeStageKeys().finished`, never a hardcoded `HIRED_660`), so every stage write path stamps through one place and a redelivered or out-of-order event converges on the same row. The row carries company, accepted offer + requisition, credited mentor, the mentee's source and the relation's `employmentAttribution`; `SELF_FOUND`/`ALREADY_EMPLOYED` get `feeModel: NONE` and `NOT_INVOICEABLE`. Leaving the hire stage sets `reversedAt` (never a delete); returning clears it. COACHING relations and verticals without `placements` are skipped. Additive `Placement` columns (`requisitionId`, `creditedMentorId`, `sourceId`, `attribution`, `feeModel`, `invoiceState` default `NOT_INVOICEABLE`, `invoiceRef`, `invoicedAt`, `reversedAt`). Pure rule in `src/lib/placementRule.ts` (`reconcilePlacement`, `canChangeInvoiceState`, unit-tested). `/admin/placements` ledger (nav `placements`) with filters and a CSV export through the `REPORT_EXPORT`-gated export door (`placements` dataset); `PATCH /api/admin/placements/[id]` moves the invoice state (`org.settings.write`, guarded `updateMany`, `AuditLog` `PLACEMENT_INVOICE_STATE`). The ROI report and the `placement-outcomes` report ignore reversed rows. No public fee page (legal check pending, see the issue).

en: New Admin › Placements ledger: every hire is recorded automatically with its company, role, mentor, source and whether it came through you — ready to filter, export and mark as invoiced.
tr: Yeni Yönetim › Yerleştirmeler defteri: her işe alım şirketi, pozisyonu, mentörü, kaynağı ve sizin aracılığınızla olup olmadığıyla birlikte otomatik kaydedilir — filtrelenebilir, dışa aktarılabilir ve faturalandı olarak işaretlenebilir.
de: Neues Register unter Admin › Vermittlungen: Jede Einstellung wird automatisch mit Unternehmen, Stelle, Mentor:in, Quelle und Zurechnung erfasst – filterbar, exportierbar und als abgerechnet markierbar.
